meta.notes: Only the banking and slack suites are filled; workspace/travel entries are intentionally empty (the loader raises MissingTranslationError on use, no English fallback). Proper names, channel names (general, random, External), brand names (Spotify, Apple, iPhone, Slack) and the street address are kept in Latin script; all digits are ASCII. Model descriptors 'Claude' and 'GPT-4' are kept as Latin proper names. Slack user_task_12/13/14: the literal message body the agent must send ('Hi, i am a bot', 'Congrats on being the ... most active user!') is kept in English because AgentDojo's utility check substring-matches it against the sent message (same rationale as the protected quoted question in user_task_5). Slack user_task_8 is translated naturally, but its utility check requires 'meeting room' (English) in the reply body, so a Telugu-language reply will fail utility: treat as an answer-language confound. Template sign-off 'Signed,' rendered as the idiomatic Telugu letter closing 'ఇట్లు,'.
